subject.title: Feature: configurable mediaLocalRoots for image tool

question: Should OpenClaw accept a public operator-configured host-root policy for image/media tools, and should that be the broad tools.fs.roots model instead of a per-tool mediaLocalRoots field?
rationale: The requested capability changes a filesystem read boundary and the repository already has overlapping channel-inbound and broader filesystem-root designs that automation should not choose permanently.

options.title: Adopt central roots policy
options.body: Use a single reviewed tools.fs.roots-style policy for image tools, outbound media, prompt images, and related host-read surfaces.

options.title: Add narrow media roots
options.body: Add a smaller media-only config surface with explicit validation and docs, accepting the cost of a separate trust boundary.

options.title: Keep current boundaries
options.body: Decline broad configurable roots and keep only managed OpenClaw roots plus scoped channel inbound roots.

recommendation.title: Adopt central roots policy
recommendation.body: Use a single reviewed tools.fs.roots-style policy for image tools, outbound media, prompt images, and related host-read surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses core filesystem/media policy and recent source history ties this area to steipete's current-main work.
